rules.content:
title: Session Cookie Exfiltration Pattern
status: experimental
description: Detects session token and cookie theft patterns in log data indicative of infostealer activity. Stealers like Lumma and Raccoon target browser cookie stores to extract active session tokens, enabling 
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: endpoint_detection
detection:
    selection_cookie_db:
        file_path|contains:
            - "\\Cookies"
            - "\\cookies.sqlite"
            - "\\Network\\Cookies"
        file_access_type: "read"
    selection_process:
        process_name|endswith:
            - ".exe"
        process_signed: false
    filter_browsers:
        process_name|endswith:
            - "\\chrome.exe"
            - "\\firefox.exe"
            - "\\msedge.exe"
            - "\\brave.exe"
    condition: (selection_cookie_db and selection_process) and not filter_browsers
level: high
rules.title: DL-0003: Session Cookie Exfiltration Pattern (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Credential Testing After Dump")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count(distinct user_id) by source_ip > 10")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:auth_logs event_type="login_attempt" (auth_result="failure" OR auth_result="success")
| stats dc(user_id) as unique_user_id by source_ip
| where unique_user_id > 10
rules.title: DL-0006: Credential Testing After Dump (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Multiple Account Access from Single Source")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count(distinct account_id) by source_ip > 5 or selection | count(distinct account_id) by device_fingerprint > 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:auth_logs event_type="login_success"
| stats dc(account_id) as unique_account_id by source_ip
| where unique_account_id > 5
| stats dc(account_id) as unique_account_id by device_fingerprint
| where unique_account_id > 3
rules.title: DL-0008: Multiple Account Access from Single Source (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Stolen Session Token Replay")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection and not filter_same_context | count() by session_token > 1")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:auth_logs
event_type="session_activity"
session_token=true
geo_country="%original_session_country%"
device_fingerprint="%original_device_fingerprint%"
| stats count as event_count by session_token
| where event_count > 1
rules.title: DL-0009: Stolen Session Token Replay (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Crypto Wallet Seed Phrase Exfiltration
status: experimental
description: Detects wallet seed phrase and private key extraction attempts targeting cryptocurrency wallets. Infostealers such as RedLine, Vidar, and StealC include dedicated modules that search for wallet.dat fi
logsource:
    product: crypto
    service: endpoint_detection
detection:
    selection_wallet_files:
        file_path|contains:
            - "\\Ethereum\\keystore"
            - "\\Exodus\\exodus.wallet"
            - "\\Electrum\\wallets"
            - "\\Bitcoin\\wallet.dat"
            - "\\Atomic\\Local Storage"
            - "\\Coinomi\\wallets"
        file_access_type: "read"
    selection_metamask:
        file_path|contains:
            - "\\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn"
            - "\\ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm"
        file_access_type: "read"
    selection_seed_files:
        file_name|contains:
            - "seed"
            - "mnemonic"
            - "recovery"
            - "backup"
        file_extension|contains:
            - ".txt"
            - ".json"
            - ".dat"
    filter_wallet_apps:
        process_name|contains:
            - "Exodus"
            - "Electrum"
            - "Atomic"
            - "Coinomi"
            - "MetaMask"
    condition: (selection_wallet_files or selection_metamask or selection_seed_files) and not filter_wallet_apps
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0011: Crypto Wallet Seed Phrase Exfiltration (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Geographic Impossibility Login")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | near by user_id | where geo_distance(src.geo_lat, src.geo_lon, dst.geo_lat, dst.geo_lon) > 1000 and time_diff < 60m")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:auth_logs (event_type="login_success" OR event_type="login_attempt")
| transaction user_id maxspan=60m
| where eventcount >= 2
rules.title: DL-0013: Geographic Impossibility Login (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Device Fingerprint Anomaly")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | where device_fingerprint in known_device_fingerprints and (

  or screen_resolution != baseline.screen_")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:web_gateway event_type="session_start" device_fingerprint=true

rules.content:
title: Residential Proxy Login Attempt
status: experimental
description: Detects login attempts originating from known residential proxy networks. Credential stuffing actors increasingly route attacks through residential proxies (Luminati/Bright Data, Oxylabs, SmartProxy) 
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: auth_logs
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "login_attempt"
            - "login_success"
    selection_proxy:
        source_ip_threat_intel|contains:
            - "residential_proxy"
            - "proxy_network"
        source_ip_category: "residential"
        source_asn_type: "isp"
    selection_additional:
        auth_result: "success"
    condition: selection and selection_proxy and selection_additional
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0017: Residential Proxy Login Attempt (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Carrier Change Authentication Correlation")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_carrier_change | followed_by selection_auth on phone_number within 120m")`
index=flame_telecom sourcetype=flame:identity_management
(event_type="sim_swap" OR event_type="carrier_change" OR event_type="number_port")
status="completed"
event_type="login_attempt"
mfa_method="sms"
mfa_result="success"
| transaction phone_number maxspan=120m
| where eventcount >= 2
`comment("Sequential correlation across stages")`
rules.title: DL-0044: Carrier Change Authentication Correlation (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: New Device High-Value Transaction
status: experimental
description: Detects a high-value financial transaction initiated from a new or previously unknown device shortly after initial authentication. Attackers who have compromised credentials and bypassed MFA via SIM s
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: transaction_monitoring
detection:
    selection_new_device:
        device_trust_level: "new"
        device_first_seen_days: 0
    selection_high_value:
        event_type: "wire_transfer"
        transaction_amount|gte: 5000
    selection_timing:
        time_since_auth_minutes|lte: 30
    condition: selection_new_device and selection_high_value and selection_timing
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0045: New Device High-Value Transaction (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for MFA Push Bombing")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count() by user_id > 5 and count(selection_denied) by user_id > 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:mfa_logs
event_type="mfa_push_sent"
mfa_method="push"
(mfa_result="denied" OR mfa_result="timeout" OR mfa_result="ignored")
| stats count as event_count by user_id
| where event_count > 5
rules.title: DL-0046: MFA Push Bombing (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for SIM Swap Indicator Chain")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: stage1_sim_change | followed_by stage2_password_reset | followed_by stage3_high_value_action on user_id within 24h")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:identity_management
(event_type="phone_number_change" OR event_type="sim_swap" OR event_type="mobile_update")
event_type="password_reset"
reset_method="sms_otp"
(event_type="wire_transfer" OR event_type="beneficiary_add" OR event_type="address_change" OR event_type="email_change")
transaction_amount>=1000
| transaction on maxspan=24h
| where eventcount >= 2
`comment("Sequential correlation across stages")`
rules.title: DL-0047: SIM Swap Indicator Chain (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: VoIP Number MFA Enrollment
status: experimental
description: Detects MFA enrollment using VoIP or virtual phone numbers instead of legitimate mobile carrier numbers. Attackers who have compromised an account often enroll a disposable VoIP number (Google Voice, 
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: mfa_logs
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "mfa_enrollment"
            - "mfa_phone_update"
            - "phone_number_add"
        mfa_method: "sms"
    selection_voip:
        phone_number_type|contains:
            - "voip"
            - "virtual"
            - "toll_free"
        phone_carrier|contains:
            - "Google Voice"
            - "TextNow"
            - "Twilio"
            - "Bandwidth"
            - "Vonage"
            - "Pinger"
    condition: selection and selection_voip
level: high
rules.title: DL-0048: VoIP Number MFA Enrollment (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: MFA Method Downgrade
status: experimental
description: Detects when an account's MFA method is changed from a strong phishing-resistant factor (FIDO2/WebAuthn, hardware token, authenticator app) to a weaker method (SMS OTP, voice call). Attackers who comp
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: identity_management
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "mfa_method_change"
            - "mfa_update"
            - "authenticator_change"
    selection_downgrade:
        previous_mfa_method|contains:
            - "fido2"
            - "webauthn"
            - "hardware_token"
            - "authenticator_app"
            - "totp"
        new_mfa_method|contains:
            - "sms"
            - "voice"
            - "email"
    condition: selection and selection_downgrade
level: high
rules.title: DL-0049: MFA Method Downgrade (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for SIM Swap Network-Level API Detection")`
`comment("Correlates SIM change signals with MFA authentication attempts")`
index=flame_telecom sourcetype=flame:number_intelligence
| eval sim_risk = case(
    sim_swap_recently == "true", "HIGH",
    device_mismatch == "true", "HIGH",
    call_forwarding_active == "true", "MEDIUM",
    1=1, "LOW"
  )
| where sim_risk IN ("HIGH", "MEDIUM")
| join type=inner max=0 phone_number [
  search index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:mfa_events
  | where mfa_channel = "SMS"
  | where _time > relative_time(now(), "-1h")
]
| table _time, phone_number, customer_id, sim_risk,
        sim_swap_recently, sim_swap_timestamp,
        device_mismatch, call_forwarding_active,
        mfa_result
rules.title: DL-0141: SIM Swap Network-Level API Detection — Pre-MFA SIM Change Verification (SPLUNK)
